name: Blue Springs
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Blue Springs for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, at least 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (CPKC Holiday Train in Downtown Blue Springs) through December 15 (Santa storytimes at Mid-Continent library branches), with the Grain Valley tree lighting (December 3), Christmas on Main (December 5) and Spirit of Christmas in Oak Grove (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Blue Springs

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Blue Springs, counting 4 already live and 5 new ones, 2 of them from nearby Oak Grove and Grain Valley
  • At least 3 free events among the new ones: the CPKC Holiday Train, Christmas on Main and Spirit of Christmas in Oak Grove
  • Meet Santa: Christmas on Main, breakfast with Santa in Oak Grove and Santa storytimes at three Mid-Continent library branches
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train in Downtown Blue Springs (November 27)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Oak Grove Christmas Parade (December 5), the Oak Grove and Grain Valley tree lightings and the North Pole Trail of Lights opening night
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 15, 2026 for the new listings

Planning a bigger day out? Blue Springs families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Kansas City, which covers Destination North Pole at Crown Center, Holiday Reflections at Union Station, the Plaza lighting ceremony and Santa visits at Zona Rosa.
